report_name: Panzer Ransomware Group Claims Attack on IT Firm Yodingenierie

threat_actors.name: Panzer
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group that engages in Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) and double extortion tactics. The group claimed responsibility for the cyberattack against Yodingenierie.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through operational disruption and data theft.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The Panzer group exfiltrated sensitive data from Yodingenierie to attacker-controlled servers before encryption as part of their double extortion tactic.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The Panzer ransomware payload was executed to encrypt files across Yodingenierie's servers and workstations, rendering them inaccessible.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The attackers likely used tools like vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, preventing easy restoration of encrypted files, as suggested by hunting hints.

malware.name: Panzer Ransomware
malware.description: The ransomware payload used by the Panzer group to encrypt victim data at Yodingenierie and exfiltrate data for double extortion.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: The vssadmin.exe utility was noted in hunting hints as a tool used to delete volume shadow copies to inhibit system recovery.

tools.name: PsExec
tools.description: PsExec was mentioned as a tool to hunt for, indicating its potential use for lateral movement in this type of attack.

identities.name: Yodingenierie
identities.description: An engineering and information technology company headquartered in Benin and a member of the NED&CO Group, targeted by the Panzer ransomware group.

identities.name: NED&CO Group
identities.description: A pan-African group focused on digital transformation, of which Yodingenierie is a member.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 2b8a1c9d-4e5f-4a9b-8c7d-6e5f4a3b2c1d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.hookphish.com/blog/ransomware-group-panzer-hits-yodingenierie/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-26
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware tactic to prevent recovery.

indicators.name: PsExec Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: PsExec Execution
id: 8d9c0b1a-3e4f-4d8c-9b6a-5e4f3d2c1b0a
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of PsExec, a legitimate remote administration tool often abused by attackers for lateral movement.
references:
  - https://www.hookphish.com/blog/ransomware-group-panzer-hits-yodingenierie/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-26
tags:
  - attack.t1021.002
  - attack.lateral_movement
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    OriginalFileName: 'psexec.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of PsExec, a tool often used for lateral movement in ransomware attacks.
